HomePage.title: ROKIO – Process Analysis for SMEs
HomePage.description: Employees share, AI brings it together, the team decides the first step.

Kopf.logoAlt: ROKIO – Find the right AI and robotics solutions together

Home.titel: Your people know where things get stuck.
Home.einleitung: ROKIO turns that into a feed: swipe cards instead of filling in forms. It shows at which handovers time is lost – and which AI or robotics solution helps exactly there.
Home.codeFrage: Got a code from the notice board?
Home.schleifeText: What one person reports, the AI turns into an anonymous card. The other teams confirm with one thumb. Every confirmation counts as a voice for exactly this handover.

gesten.kenn: Know it – a voice for this handover
gesten.nicht: Don't know it – counts as a vote against
gesten.staendig: Happens all the time – frequent and stressful
gesten.halten: Press and hold – tell more, by voice or one sentence

Home.bildText: The handover map shows where time is lost between teams – never who is to blame. Hourly-rate ranges turn “annoying” into a number.
Home.bildZahlText: ≈ {euro} per year in the demo metalworks (fictional)
Home.karteHinweis: Handover map of a fictional metalworking company

metallbau.stimme: We built a railing from the old drawing.
metallbau.loesung: Change agent: a change is said once and is correct everywhere.

pflege.stimme: At handover everyone talks fast and in abbreviations.
pflege.loesung: Handover assistant: in every language, without jargon.

mensa.stimme: Between twelve and two the return belt overflows.
mensa.loesung: Return with eyes: the dish room reports what was overcooked.

Home.vertrauenText: People who are afraid don't swipe honestly. That's why these rules are on the first card, not in the small print.
regeln: Management sees a topic only from three voices.
No individual answers, no names, no timestamps.
Voice becomes text, audio is not stored.
Nobody sees whether or when someone swipes.
In real use, the AI runs locally.
The works council is involved from the start (§ 87 (1) no. 6 BetrVG).
Home.schluss: Give them a reason to say it.
Home.ehrlich: The demo uses fictional companies. Maturity and origin are shown for every solution.
Home.simEndeText: Three cards, a few seconds. In the real feed every gesture counts as a voice.
Home.simHinweis: Simulation – swipe the card. Nothing is saved.

Eingabe.fehler: Speaking didn't work ({grund}). You can also type.
